responsibility: Defines the rustc-internal side of the Stable MIR bridge: public entry points for stable↔internal translation, table helpers that intern and recover IDs/spans/layouts/instances, thread-local execution context management for those tables, driver macros for running rustc with Stable MIR initialized, and the `RustcInternal` trait plus supporting indexed map infrastructure used by the conversions.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other same-named modules, this one is the Stable-MIR-to-rustc escape hatch: it recovers internal `DefId`/`CrateNum` values from stable handles, exposes `run` on top of a `TyCtxt`, and works through `rustc_tables` to access the internal `Tables`. The other `mod.rs` files either define the public stable API surface (`stable_mir`) or implement one-way rustc-to-stable lowering (`rustc_smir`).
